note: Only the 50 newest of 3 days come back; first name cut at 40 letters, line at 220
Plan-request urgency uses the India date; the 3-day window is in hours
Alerts missed while the app is closed come by browser push (0076) or the next poll
Summary setting changes when push goes, never what the bell lists
Lines up to 220 letters must wrap in the bell
Alerts written in 0075 words are reworded by the admin app
Member acts in the app, the panel bell must show it on every signed-in device
Member list name used for the first name
Renew request urgent when the plan ends in 3 days or less, India date
The member waits at the door; a missed poll delays the desk
Only the owner changes the timing; urgent ones go at once anyway
Desk often uses a tablet or a phone
Message alerts written before 0096 have threads with no recipient: the old rule must hold
Number typed on the member's phone, alert on the desk device
A trainer with no questions sees only gym-wide alerts or none

why_not: no time edge for a trainer's question alert: it is kept by a 3-day window in hours, not by a calendar day
note: none
The next poll after the internet comes back must still bring the alert
A question alert is not urgent: summary setting decides when the push goes
Trainers use phones on the floor
Old 'asked a trainer a question' words reworded in the admin app
Member picks the trainer in the app; only that trainer's panel rings
Name and label are cut to fit the 220-letter line; a too-short line fails only as a warning
Urgency of a plan request is decided with the India date at write time
One alert per tag: a retried hand-over or event must not make two
The alert is always written; the setting only changes when it is pushed

why_not: the system role has no screen: it only writes rows and answers calls
note: none
0096 changed who sees message alerts; rows made before it must follow the old rule
Written from the member app's action, read by the admin app
